THE COMMONWEALTH OF MASSACHUSETTS
OFFICE OF STATE PLANNING
JOHN W. McCORMACK BUILDING ROOM 2101 ONE ASHBURTON PLACE BOSTO!!, MASSACHUSETTS 02108 (617) 727-5066
FRANK T. KEEFE
GOVERNOR
November 28, 1975
Mr. David Strohm, Director
Mayor's Office of Community Development
Room 703
City Hall
Boston, MA
RE: A-95 Review/Draft Environmental Impact Statement for the Clearance of Unsafe Buildings
State Clearinghouse Identifier 75101146
Dear Mr. Strohm:
The City of Boston has included the clearance of unsafe buildings as a major component of its Community Development Block Grant program. In accordance with federal regulations, the above cited Draft Environmental Impact Statement was prepared in order to begin to assess the impact this clearance will have on the community. The Office of State Planning has completed its review of this document, and we would like to inform you of our findings.
The Department of Environmental Quality Engineering (DEQE) has found the Draft EIS to be inadequate. Numerous substantive concerns were raised in the DEQE review relative to the adequacy of information included in the Draft on air quality, water quality, and solid waste. (See attached DEQE comments.) The Office of State Planning finds that the comments prepared by DEQE warrent special consideration and therefore recommends that these issues be addressed in a Final Environmental Impact Statement.
Also, the Department of Public Works would like to be assured that the project implementation includes coordination with state and local traffic agencies so as to alleviate temporary congestion and re-routing problems.
In conclusion, we hope these comments will be helpful in developing a Final EIS and we look forward to reviewing the document upon its completion.
Sincere
Frank T. Keefe
Director of State Planning
ce: William Hernandez, HUD Evelyn Murphy, EOEA
